label: C-MOON-M4-LANEC-01
title: Lane C -- synthetic-epoch commodity fabric (R-EP D1-D5)
objective: Establish the R-EP epoch semantics on SYNTHETIC epochs only: a pure epoch unit with a transport-independent SHA-256 semantic identity (D1), CAS publication with explicit PUBLISHED / DUPLICATE / DISAGREEMENT-QUARANTINE / AMBIGUOUS outcomes and validation as a separate state (D2), the twelve-case fault-injection matrix under both single-ref and per-chain-ref layouts (D3, tests first), a preregistered transport study on a disposable local-network bare remote plus one bounded GitHub WAN-semantics arm (D4), and node auto-join without auto-authorization (D5). No organisms, world physics, S-meter or RSO evidence.
sources: moonshot/epoch/CONTRACT.md; roles/Themis/design/MOONSHOT_DESIGN_v0.3.md (R-EP, N1, N3, N4, N5, N7); roles/Themis/design/LANE_C_M4_KICKOFF.md; roles/Themis/design/MOONSHOT_DESIGN_v0.2_ASTRA_REVIEW.md F08
